4a71a2a0e0e10835.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة أريس للتشغيل والصيانة عن مهندس زراعي للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة خصائص الأراضي الزراعية وتصميم شبكات الري والصرف، بالإضافة إلى تحديد الآلات الزراعية المناسبة وتطوير استخداماتها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام الرئيسية يتولى المهندس الزراعي مسؤولية مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لضمان كفاءة العمليات الزراعية وتحسينها. تشمل هذه المهام دراسة التربة، تصميم أنظمة الري، وتحديد الآلات الزراعية المناسبة. دراسة الخصائص الفيزيائية والكيميائية للتربة الزراعية ومكوناتها. متابعة فحص عينات النبات والتربة ومياه الري وتحليل نتائجها. دراسة واختبار أنواع الأسمدة المناسبة وتقييم مدى استجابة المزروعات لها. دراسة أنظمة الري المتاحة واختيار الأنسب منها (كالري السطحي، بالرشاشات، المحوري، أو الموضعي). تصميم مخططات وشبكات الري والصرف الزراعي ومتابعة إجراءات التركيب. تقييم كفاءة أنظمة الري وتطويرها لتحقيق أفضل النتائج. تحديد الآلات الزراعية المناسبة مثل آلات الحراثة، الزراعة، الرش، الحصاد، وآلات جرش وخلط الحبوب. إعداد برامج تشغيل وصيانة الآلات الزراعية والتأكد من جاهزيتها للعمل. تطوير العمل وإعداد التقارير يتضمن الدور أيضاً مسؤولية تطوير أساليب العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال الزراعي، بالإضافة إلى توثيق جميع الأعمال والنتائج بشكل احترافي. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل الحالية ومواكبة التطورات التقنية الحديثة في القطاع الزراعي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال، وعرضها وتوضيحها. حفظ التقارير والوثائق في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة في المؤسسة. المؤهلات والخبرة لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الزراعية. القدرة على دراسة وتحليل خصائص التربة والمياه والنباتات. مهارات في تصميم وتطوير شبكات الري والصرف الزراعي. معرفة بالآلات الزراعية المختلفة وبرامج تشغيلها وصيانتها. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة. سيعمل المهندس الزراعي ضمن فريق متخصص في مؤسسة أريس للتشغيل والصيانة، حيث تتاح الفرصة للمساهمة في مشاريع زراعية مهمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

4aaeeecb475e728a.description: About SYSTRA SYSTRA is seeking a Civil Inspector to join the Project Management Consultant (PMC) team for a metro project in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position for a Saudi National. Role Overview The Civil Inspector will be responsible for monitoring and inspecting civil works on site. The primary objective is to ensure that all construction activities adhere to approved drawings, project specifications, contract requirements, established quality standards, and applicable health and safety regulations. Key Responsibilities Conduct routine and detailed inspections of civil works at the site. Ensure all works comply with approved drawings, specifications, method statements, and relevant codes and standards. Inspect materials delivered to site and verify compliance with approved submittals. Witness site tests and inspections in accordance with the inspection and test plan. Monitor contractor workmanship and construction practices to ensure quality requirements are achieved. Identify non-conforming work and report deficiencies to the Resident Engineer or relevant supervision personnel. Maintain inspection requests, site records, checklists, photographs, and daily reports. Verify that corrective actions are implemented and closed out in a timely manner. Coordinate with QA/QC personnel and other engineering disciplines on interface and compliance matters. Support progress monitoring by reporting actual site status and construction issues. Ensure health, safety, and environmental requirements are observed during the execution of works. Assist with snagging, de-snagging, substantial completion inspections, and handover processes. Qualifications and Experience This position is open to Saudi Nationals only. A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in civil inspection or a related field. Demonstrated experience in metro or large-scale infrastructure projects is preferred. Work Location The role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

The company values its co-workers and is seeking a dedicated Country Talent Acquisition Specialist to join its People & Culture team. This full-time role, based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, covers stores, the Service Office, and various business functions. The specialist will be instrumental in attracting talent, managing recruitment operations, and ensuring a consistent hiring experience. Key Responsibilities Manage end-to-end recruitment, including sourcing, screening, interviews, assessments, offer preparation, and onboarding coordination. Coordinate and monitor recruitment activities across IKEA stores and the Service Office, ensuring alignment with manpower plans and hiring priorities. Partner with hiring managers and People & Culture teams to understand recruitment needs and provide timely updates. Support high-volume recruitment, store openings, and expansion, while maintaining talent pipelines for recurring vacancies. Manage Tamheer, internship, and graduate programs, including trainee selection, registration, follow-up, and reporting. Handle HRDF employment support registrations, ensuring employee eligibility, timely submissions, and accurate records. Support internal recruitment, employee transfers, promotions, and talent mobility initiatives. Coordinate recruitment compliance, approvals, and employment requirements with HR Operations and stakeholders. Support onboarding activities to ensure a smooth new joiner experience. Participate in employer branding initiatives, career fairs, and university partnerships. Maintain recruitment trackers, monitor hiring KPIs, and prepare monthly recruitment reports, dashboards, and presentations. Identify opportunities to improve recruitment processes, sourcing strategies, candidate experience, and overall hiring efficiency. 4a3ed60509960f71.description: About the Role CHINT is seeking a Mechanical Design Engineer to join our team in Dammam, Eastern Province. This full-time role involves developing practical and manufacturable mechanical designs for MV switchgear, ensuring correct component integration, assembly access, and compliance with approved product requirements. The position is based at our factory in Third Industrial City, Dammam. Key Responsibilities Review project specifications, electrical layouts, installation conditions, and dimensional restrictions. Prepare general arrangement drawings, sheet metal details, assembly drawings, and manufacturing documents. Design enclosures, compartments, doors, brackets, mounting structures, and component supports. Develop mechanical and busbar arrangements in coordination with Electrical Design and approved product configurations. Prepare mechanical bills of materials and material specifications. 4a3fbc86b52030cc.description: About the Role Qiddiya is seeking a Cluster Finance Director to join its team in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing all finance, accounting, treasury, procurement controls, financial planning, reporting, and governance functions across multiple hotels within the portfolio. The Cluster Finance Director will report to the Cluster General Manager and serve as a strategic business partner to ownership and hotel leadership teams. This position is critical throughout the pre-opening, opening, stabilization, and operational phases of the hotels, ensuring sound financial management, strong governance, effective cash flow planning, and long-term value creation. The role combines commercial acumen, financial stewardship, and project finance expertise to support a portfolio of hotels with different positioning, customer segments, and operating models. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute a cluster-wide financial strategy aligned with ownership objectives, business plans, and brand standards. Serve as a strategic advisor to the Cluster General Manager and hotel leadership teams on financial opportunities, risks, and business performance. Lead all finance-related pre-opening activities, including developing and managing the Finance Pre-Opening Critical Path and readiness plan. Prepare, review, and manage Pre-Opening Budgets (POB) for all hotels within the cluster and monitor expenditures. Establish accounting structures, financial controls, approval matrices, and reporting frameworks prior to opening. Lead the preparation of annual budgets, business plans, forecasts, and long-range financial projections, consolidating financial planning across multiple entities. Develop and manage cash flow forecasts across the hotel portfolio, monitoring working capital requirements and supporting funding requests. Oversee all accounting, financial reporting, audit, tax, compliance, and internal control activities, ensuring accurate and timely reporting. Implement financial control procedures for procurement, contracts, purchasing, and inventory management, driving cost optimization initiatives. Act as the primary finance business partner for ownership, preparing reports, cash flow forecasts, and performance updates. Build and lead high-performing finance and accounting teams, developing succession plans and talent pipelines. Qualifications and Requirements Over 10 years of proven finance leadership experience within hotels, hospitality portfolios, mixed-use developments, or complex service businesses. Strong pre-opening experience, including POB preparation, financial system implementation, operational readiness, and opening support. Experience developing hotel budgets, long-term business plans, forecasts, and cash flow models. Strong understanding of hotel finance, management agreements, and owner reporting requirements. Experience supporting working capital planning, funding requests, and treasury management activities. Strong knowledge of financial controls, accounting standards, audits, tax compliance, and governance requirements. Demonstrated ability to convert financial analysis into operational and strategic recommendations. Strong leadership, communication, and influencing skills. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be a commercially minded finance leader with a strong track record of supporting hotel openings, financial planning, governance, and portfolio performance. This role requires a professional who can establish robust financial processes, drive profitability, manage risk, and support strategic decision-making across the portfolio. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring active engagement with multiple hotel leadership teams and ownership stakeholders within the Qiddiya portfolio.

4a68491ed7c80c27.description: About CSI Global CSI Global is a leading multidisciplinary engineering and technical services company. The company specializes in MEP, testing and diagnostics, commissioning, construction management, quality control, BIM, sustainability, and mission-critical solutions. With international project experience across more than 20 countries, CSI Global supports clients from design through construction, commissioning, handover, and operational readiness, delivering technically robust and performance-focused solutions for complex projects. The Role of Document Coordinator CSI Global is seeking a Document Coordinator to join its team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting project teams in managing, controlling, tracking, and maintaining project documentation. The Document Coordinator will ensure that all project documents are properly received, reviewed for completeness, distributed to relevant stakeholders, and maintained in accordance with company and project document-control procedures. Key Responsibilities Coordinate the receipt, registration, distribution, and filing of project documents. Maintain accurate document registers, transmittals, logs, and tracking sheets. Ensure all documents are properly coded, numbered, dated, and version-controlled. Coordinate document submissions and ensure timely distribution to project stakeholders. Monitor document status, revisions, approvals, comments, and outstanding actions. Maintain both electronic and physical project documentation in an organized manner. Coordinate with Project Managers, Engineers, Consultants, Contractors, and other stakeholders regarding document submissions and requirements. Prepare and issue transmittals, correspondence, submittals, and document distribution records. Follow up on pending approvals, comments, and overdue document submissions. Ensure superseded documents are properly identified and archived to prevent the use of obsolete information. Maintain project correspondence and records in accordance with established document-control procedures. Support the project team with document retrieval and provide required reports and document-status updates. Assist in preparing periodic document-control reports for project management. Ensure confidentiality, accuracy, and integrity of project information. Perform other document-control and administrative duties as assigned by management. Candidate Requirements The ideal candidate will be highly organized and detail-oriented, possessing 2-5 years of relevant experience in document coordination or a similar role. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail are essential for managing complex project documentation effectively. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in Mecca, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The Document Coordinator will work closely with various project stakeholders, including Project Managers, Engineers, Consultants, and Contractors, in a dynamic project-driven environment.

4aa940a91e8cfc1e.description: Job Summary 2P Perfect Presentation is seeking an experienced MSSQL Database Administrator to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft SQL Server administration, focusing on high availability, disaster recovery, clustering, performance optimization, and database operations. The administrator will be responsible for managing, maintaining, securing, and optimizing Microsoft SQL Server environments across multiple platforms, ensuring high availability, scalability, performance, and reliable disaster recovery capabilities. Key Responsibilities Manage, configure, and maintain Microsoft SQL Server databases across multiple environments. Ensure database performance, security, availability, and operational stability. Implement and maintain High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) solutions. Support and troubleshoot clustered database environments. Perform regular database backup, restore, and recovery activities. Monitor database health, capacity, performance, and scalability. Coordinate with application, infrastructure, and technical teams to support business-critical systems. Maintain technical documentation and operational procedures. Provide basic support for Oracle Database Administration when required. Qualifications and Experience Minimum 8+ years of hands-on experience in core Database Administration. Minimum 5 years of experience in Microsoft SQL Server Administration. Strong hands-on experience in HA/DR, clustering, backup, recovery, and database troubleshooting. Proven experience managing enterprise Microsoft SQL Server environments. Basic knowledge and experience in Oracle Administration. Strong troubleshooting capabilities in Cluster and Disaster Recovery environments. Good understanding of database performance, security, scalability, and availability. Required Skills Proficiency in Microsoft SQL Server administration. Expertise in high availability and disaster recovery solutions. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for database troubleshooting. Good written and spoken English communication skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring a professional who can collaborate effectively with various technical teams to support critical business systems.

Lead multidisciplinary project teams, consultants, contractors, and subcontractors. Manage project budgets, schedules, risks, change, quality, HSE, and overall performance. Coordinate utility interfaces with other infrastructure packages, roads, developments, and public realm works. Manage relationships with government authorities, utility providers, developers, consultants, and other key stakeholders, including technical approvals and permits. Drive resolution of utility conflicts, diversions, design issues, constructability constraints, and project interface risks. 4acfb3ad6935268a.description: About the Role Nesma United Industries is seeking a Junior Irrigation Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is ideal for fresh graduates with 0-1 years of experience who are looking to gain practical experience in irrigation projects. Role Overview The Junior Irrigation Engineer will provide essential support across various stages of irrigation projects, from initial design documentation to on-site coordination and final handover. This role offers an opportunity to develop foundational skills in irrigation engineering within a professional environment. Key Responsibilities Support the preparation of irrigation shop drawings and technical documentation. Assist with pipe sizing and hydraulic calculations for irrigation systems. Coordinate irrigation layouts effectively with other site utilities. Assist in the creation of as-built drawings and handover documents. 4a12e88fd3bbbd76.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة بروفانتا عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة، وتحديداً في ينبع. يركز هذا الدور على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء، ترويج المنتجات، وإتمام عمليات البيع، بالإضافة إلى متابعة التحصيلات. هذه فرصة للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة المبكرة في مجال المبيعات. الغرض من الوظيفة يتولى مندوب المبيعات مسؤولية جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات والخدمات، وإعداد قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء. يشمل الدور التواصل المباشر مع العملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين لتقديم عروض البيع، إتمام الصفقات، ومتابعة تحصيل الديون، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير الدورية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، مع توثيق بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء من خلال الزيارات الميدانية أو المكالمات لترويج المنتجات والخدمات، وتقديم عروض البيع مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزاتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار المعتمدة ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المحددة، وإتمام عمليات البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. تحصيل ديون العملاء وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، ثم توريدها إلى الدائرة المالية المختصة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو دور ذي صلة. القدرة على جمع البيانات وتحليلها. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في المدينة المنورة، ينبع. يتطلب العمل التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء والعمل ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

4a50b49d3c32c01e.description: About the Role Tamweel Aloula is seeking a Safety Security Officer to join its team in Dhahran, Eastern region. This full-time role involves maintaining a safe and secure workplace, ensuring compliance with safety regulations, and supporting emergency preparedness. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Role Overview The Safety Security Officer is responsible for identifying potential risks, implementing safety and security procedures, and ensuring the organization adheres to all applicable safety standards. This role is critical in fostering a secure environment for all employees and operations. Key Responsibilities Implement and monitor workplace safety and security procedures. Conduct regular safety inspections, identify hazards, and follow up on corrective actions. Ensure fire protection, emergency, and first-aid equipment are properly maintained. Support emergency response plans, evacuation procedures, and safety drills. Investigate workplace incidents and maintain accurate safety records. Conduct employee safety awareness and training activities. Ensure compliance with Saudi Civil Defense requirements, the Saudi Building Code, and applicable safety regulations. Prepare safety reports and provide management with updates on risks and compliance. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a safety and security role. Demonstrated ability to implement and monitor safety protocols. Familiarity with conducting safety inspections and hazard identification. Experience with emergency preparedness and response activities. Knowledge of Saudi Civil Defense requirements and the Saudi Building Code. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dhahran, Eastern region, within a professional corporate setting at Tamweel Aloula. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the qualifications are encouraged to apply.

Interface with other departments to obtain necessary input for discipline designs and drawings. Maintain close coordination with other disciplines and entities such as Engineering, Project Management Team, Procurement, Fabrication, and Construction. Raise technical queries to clarify work scope, obtain missing information, and ensure adherence to company procedures, specifications, standards, practices, and operational requirements. Attend project review meetings, vendor meetings, engineering meetings, and offshore site surveys as needed. The company prides itself on setting the standard for luxury service and fostering a culture where employees are empowered to be creative, thoughtful, and compassionate. As part of Marriott International's portfolio of brands, The Ritz-Carlton emphasizes its "Gold Standards," which guide daily operations and define its reputation as a global leader in luxury hospitality. Role Summary The Commis role involves supporting kitchen operations by preparing ingredients and cooking food according to established recipes and quality standards. This full-time position requires 0-1 years of experience and is integral to maintaining the high culinary standards of The Ritz-Carlton. The successful candidate will contribute to a professional kitchen environment, ensuring adherence to food safety and presentation guidelines. Key Responsibilities Prepare ingredients, including portioning, chopping, and storing food items. Wash and peel fresh fruits and vegetables. Weigh, measure, and mix ingredients accurately. Prepare and cook food in accordance with recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and the food preparation checklist. Prepare cold food items. Communicate professionally and clearly with colleagues and supervisors. Develop and maintain positive working relationships, supporting team goals and addressing concerns appropriately. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards in all tasks. Physical Requirements Ability to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods or an entire work shift. Capability to reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing up to 25 pounds without assistance. Additional Duties The Commis will perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors, contributing to the overall efficiency and success of the kitchen operations.

4a71ccd309fd2974.description: About the Role ArcelorMittal Tubular Products Al-Jubail is seeking a Manager, Corporate Strategy to lead the evaluation, structuring, and coordination of strategic initiatives. This full-time role is based in Dhahran or Al Jubail and involves translating top management's strategic direction into actionable, rigorously assessed initiatives, ensuring alignment with the company’s 10-year vision, strategic planning cycles, and execution frameworks. Role Purpose and Context The Manager, Corporate Strategy will supervise the Corporate Strategy team, guiding them through the assessment and implementation of key strategic projects. This position is central to maintaining coherence across departments by aligning initiative timelines and execution milestones with the broader macro-planning framework. Key Responsibilities Lead and oversee the Analysts and Senior Analysts within the Corporate Strategy team, including workload allocation, quality control, coaching, and professional development. Structure, prioritize, and maintain the portfolio of strategic initiatives, ensuring alignment with the company’s long-term growth strategy and 10-year vision. Supervise feasibility studies and strategic assessments that cover market, industrial, financial, and organizational aspects. Consolidate and validate project analyses, reports, and presentations for submission to the Director and Executive Management. Provide macro-assumptions and external insights to inform the company’s annual 10-year planning cycle and commercial roadmap. Align initiative timelines and execution milestones with the macro-planning framework to ensure departmental coherence. Act as the operational gatekeeper for strategic projects, ensuring initiatives are well-structured before presentation to senior leadership. 4a64a9f2f0cebd23.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة جوي فود التجارية عن كاتب موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى دعم عمليات الموارد البشرية من خلال إدارة سجلات الموظفين، ومعالجة الطلبات المختلفة، وضمان سرية البيانات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الموارد البشرية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية حفظ وتحديث سجلات الموظفين، وتسجيل البيانات الشخصية للموظفين الجدد، والتأكد من اكتمال الوثائق المقدمة. معالجة ومتابعة طلبات التوظيف، والترقية، والنقل، والإعارة، وجمع بيانات إضافية عند الحاجة. تسجيل الوقوعات المتعلقة بحالة الموظف وتحديث بياناته المسجلة، وحفظ المستندات المؤيدة لهذه الوقوعات، وإخطار الجهات ذات الصلة. الحفاظ على سرية بيانات الموظفين والتعامل معها بحرص، والتحقق من عدم تسريبها أو تداولها إلا مع الأطراف المعنية وفقًا للتعليمات الموضوعة. إعداد التقارير المتعلقة بالتوظيف ورفعها إلى المختصين. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الموارد البشرية أو دور مماثل. القدرة على التعامل مع البيانات الحساسة والحفاظ على سريتها. مهارات تنظيمية وإدارية ممتازة للتعامل مع السجلات والوثائق. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة جوي فود التجارية في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور الالتزام بالعمل المكتبي والتعاون مع الأقسام الأخرى لضمان سير العمليات بسلاسة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. نشجع المتقدمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على تقديم طلباتهم.

4acc214244b8e3ab.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a Contracts and Claims Specialist to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves establishing and supporting commercial and contract management arrangements within a Project Management Office (PMO) setup for a major technology and infrastructure program. The specialist will contribute to sound procurement documentation, clear contractual obligations, proportionate risk allocation, and the early identification and prevention of claims. Key Responsibilities The Contracts and Claims Specialist will provide commercial and contractual analysis for assigned packages, collaborating with Project Managers, technical specialists, project controls, and client procurement, legal, and finance teams. Responsibilities include: Developing practical contract administration procedures, review checklists, and templates aligned with PMO governance and client approval arrangements. Establishing contract, obligations, notices, commercial risk, change, and claims registers with clear ownership and reporting requirements. Supporting the selection of appropriate contracting models and commercial arrangements for each package. Reviewing tender and contract documents for consistency across scope, deliverables, pricing, milestones, payment provisions, and acceptance criteria. Assessing proposed terms, qualifications, exclusions, and departures to identify commercial exposure. Supporting bidder clarifications and commercial evaluations, preparing commercial inputs for negotiation and award recommendations. Maintaining visibility of key obligations, deliverables, notice periods, payment milestones, and warranties for assigned contracts. Drafting and reviewing contractual correspondence and supporting change identification, contractual assessment, and valuation. Identifying ambiguous scope, inconsistent requirements, and unmanaged interfaces that may lead to contractual disputes. Monitoring potential claims, maintaining supporting records, and escalating matters to accountable program and client owners. Assessing contractual entitlement and supporting evidence for changes or claims, coordinating time and cost analysis with Project Controls. Preparing reasoned recommendations and assisting with resolution discussions for claims. Providing accurate contract status, change exposure, claims, obligations, and commercial risk information for program reviews and PMO reporting. Maintaining traceable records of contractual decisions, approvals, and correspondence. Guiding client and PMO personnel in the use of contract registers, change and claims procedures, and correspondence controls. Transferring procedures, records, and open procurement, change, and claims matters to nominated owners during project handover. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this role should possess the following: A minimum of 8 to 10 years of relevant experience in contracts and claims management. Demonstrated ability to establish and support commercial and contract management arrangements within a PMO environment. Experience with procurement documentation, contractual obligations, risk allocation, and claims prevention. Strong analytical skills for commercial and contractual assessments. Proficiency in developing and implementing contract administration procedures and registers. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a PMO setup, collaborating with various internal and client teams, including project managers, technical specialists, project controls, procurement, legal, and finance departments. Application Process Salary for this position will be disclosed during the recruitment process. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

4a219dd83e06f693.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث Makarem Al Nokhba عن مشرف دعم فني للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة. سيلعب هذا الدور محوريًا في تقديم الدعم الفني للعملاء، مما يساهم في تعزيز تجربتهم ورضاهم. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 5 و10 سنوات في مجال الدعم الفني. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقديم الدعم الفني الفوري للعملاء من خلال الاستجابة السريعة والفعالة للمشكلات الفنية. تدريب وتوجيه أعضاء الفريق الجدد على إجراءات الدعم الفني وأفضل الممارسات. تحليل المشكلات التقنية وتقديم حلول باستخدام أدوات تحليل البيانات. التنسيق مع الفرق الداخلية لضمان تلبية احتياجات العملاء بفعالية. إعداد تقارير دورية عن أداء الدعم الفني وتقديم التوصيات لتحسين العمليات. تطوير استراتيجيات جديدة لتعزيز كفاءة الدعم الفني، بما في ذلك استخدام تقنيات جديدة. إجراء تقييمات دورية لرضا العملاء وجمع الملاحظات لتحسين جودة الخدمة. مراقبة أداء الفريق وتقديم ملاحظات بناءة لتحسين الأداء العام. التفاعل مع العملاء عبر قنوات متعددة مثل الهاتف والبريد الإلكتروني والدردشة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 5 و10 سنوات في مجال الدعم الفني. القدرة على العمل تحت الضغط وحل المشكلات التقنية بفعالية. شغف بالتكنولوجيا وحل المشكلات. بيئة العمل ستكون جزءًا من فريق متنوع يشجع على الابتكار والتعاون. تلتزم الشركة بتقديم برامج تدريبية مستمرة لمساعدة الموظفين على تطوير مهاراتهم والتقدم في مسيرتهم المهنية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل في جدة. فرص التطوير المهني توفر الشركة فرصًا لتطوير المهارات القيادية واكتساب خبرات قيمة في التعامل مع التحديات الفنية المختلفة، مما يفتح آفاقًا للتقدم الوظيفي ضمن بيئة داعمة للنمو والتعلم المستمر. التقديم إذا كنت تبحث عن فرصة لتعزيز مهاراتك في بيئة تشجع على النمو والتعلم، ندعوك للتقديم على هذا الدور.

4a3dcd7d1ca25f86.description: About the Role Alpin is seeking a Senior Electrical Commissioning Engineer (ICA) to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves leading the electrical commissioning process for major projects, ensuring systems are tested, validated, and integrated according to specifications and standards. The position requires 5-10 years of experience, with a strong focus on commissioning within large-scale commercial, residential, or infrastructure developments. Key Responsibilities Lead the electrical commissioning process from pre-commissioning through functional performance testing (FPT) and handover phases. Develop, review, and approve comprehensive Commissioning Plans, Method Statements, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), and functional testing scripts for all electrical systems. Coordinate and witness Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and Site Acceptance Tests (SAT) for major electrical equipment. Oversee testing and commissioning of Main Distribution Boards (MDBs), Sub-Main Distribution Boards (SMDBs), Motor Control Centers (MCCs), transformers, switchgear, and diesel generators. Validate emergency lighting systems, Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPS), lightning protection, earthing/grounding systems, and power factor correction banks. Verify integration of electrical systems with BMS, Fire Alarm Systems, and ELV/Security networks. Ensure all site activities comply with project specifications, design intent, ASHRAE/CIBSE guidelines, and local statutory requirements. Review electrical shop drawings, submittals, and schematic diagrams to identify potential coordination or commissioning issues. Manage snagging, issue tracking, and resolution using industry platforms (*, CxAlloy, Aconex). Act as the primary technical point of contact for clients, main contractors, consultants, and statutory authorities regarding electrical commissioning matters. Lead regular coordination and progress meetings with project stakeholders and multidisciplinary engineering teams. Prepare and submit detailed commissioning progress reports, technical logs, and final handover documentation packages. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university. Minimum of 6 to 10 years of progressive experience in electrical engineering. At least 5 years focused specifically on testing and commissioning (Cx) within major commercial, residential, or infrastructure projects. Valid Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE) membership/registration is required. Recognized commissioning credentials (*, CxA, BCxP, or equivalent) are highly preferred. Required Skills In-depth knowledge of international standards (IEC, IEEE, BS, NFPA, NEC). Proven experience utilizing specialized testing equipment (*, insulation resistance testers, multi-function meters, power quality analyzers). Familiarity with commissioning and project management software (*, CxAlloy, Oracle Aconex, Smartsheet). Strong leadership, team management, and problem-solving abilities. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English. Arabic proficiency is a strong advantage. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, working within a multidisciplinary engineering team on significant projects.

4a3cd5e2fa8eb0f8.description: About the Role Ericsson is seeking a Packet Core Support Solution Architect to join its Customer Support organization in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Develop and coordinate solutions to restore and maintain network stability. Provide technical leadership during major incidents, emergency handling, customer escalations, and crisis situations. Take end-to-end ownership of assigned solutions throughout investigation, resolution, and service improvement processes. Build strong customer relationships by understanding their network environment, priorities, and operational requirements. Collaborate with engineers and cross-functional teams to share knowledge and improve troubleshooting efficiency. Identify product, process, and service improvements, translating technical findings into clear requirements. Identify potential business opportunities arising from customer requirements and operational challenges. Escalate recurring problems, process deficiencies, and operational irregularities to relevant stakeholders. Create and maintain known solutions and technical knowledge articles. Apply relevant Solution Management and global support processes. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Strong knowledge of customer networks and operational processes. In-depth understanding of Packet Core technologies. 4a5ac0b3ac585377.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أحمد صالح الغامدي وأولاده للتجارة والعقار عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة العمليات المالية، بدءًا من إعداد المستندات وحتى إعداد التقارير النهائية، مع ضمان الدقة والامتثال للمعايير المحاسبية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بناءً على الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات، وتدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في هذا المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بمحاسبة النفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال المحاسبة. إلمام تام وخبرة في التعامل مع الضريبة والزكاة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المالية بدقة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق عمل في شركة أحمد صالح الغامدي وأولاده للتجارة والعقار بالدمام. تتطلب الوظيفة الالتزام بالمعايير المحاسبية وتطوير الإجراءات المالية باستمرار. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم مراجعة جميع الطلبات بعناية.

4af2c5be800b5418.description: About the Role GEN PLUS Group is seeking a Social Data & Analytics Specialist to join its Social & Digital team. Develop and maintain performance dashboards, reports, and KPI tracking frameworks for both clients and internal teams. Analyze audience behavior, engagement metrics, reach, impressions, follower growth, content performance, and conversion rates. Translate complex data into clear insights and practical recommendations to enhance content strategy and campaign performance. Measure the effectiveness of organic and paid social campaigns, identifying opportunities for optimization. Solid understanding of various social media platforms and their respective analytics. Proficiency in digital marketing concepts and audience behavior analysis. Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for diverse audiences. A strong communicator capable of explaining data implications and recommending strategic actions. 4a1e08cdfc6155ec.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث مؤسسة سليمان محمد عجرم العنزي للمقاولات عن فني صيانة مبانٍ للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة الجوف، وتحديداً في قرية العليا والقريات. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة خطط الصيانة الدورية للمباني، وإعداد قوائم المواد اللازمة لأعمال الصيانة، ومتابعة التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى قياس الأعمال المنجزة وتدقيقها وإعداد المطالبات المالية. هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة تفاصيل خطة الصيانة الدورية لمختلف الأبنية، وتحديد العيوب الفنية، ومناقشة طرق معالجتها مع المهندس المختص. إعداد قائمة بالمواد الضرورية لتنفيذ أعمال الصيانة المتنوعة، بالإضافة إلى تحديد الأدوات والمعدات والعمال المطلوبين لإنجاز العمل. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الدورية والطارئة، والتحقق من مطابقة الأعمال المنفذة للمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. توضيح تفاصيل المخططات للمرؤوسين، ومتابعة حضور فرق العمل المختلفة، ورفع تقارير دورية حول الأعمال المنجزة. قياس الأعمال المنجزة، وحساب كمياتها وتدقيقها، وإعداد المطالبات المالية بالتنسيق مع محاسب الكميات، وتسليم الأعمال لجهة الإشراف. العمل كفني دهان ضمن مشروع نظافة وصيانة وتشغيل المدينة السكنية في منفذ الحديثة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال صيانة المباني. القدرة على قراءة المخططات الفنية وتحديد العيوب. مهارات جيدة في إعداد قوائم المواد والأدوات والمعدات. القدرة على متابعة تنفيذ الأعمال والتحقق من جودتها. مهارات تواصل فعالة مع المهندسين وفرق العمل. القدرة على قياس الكميات وإعداد المطالبات المالية. بيئة العمل يعمل فني صيانة المباني ضمن فريق مؤسسة سليمان محمد عجرم العنزي للمقاولات في منطقة الجوف، وتحديداً في مدينتي قرية العليا والقريات. تتطلب الوظيفة العمل بدوام كامل في بيئة تتطلب الدقة والالتزام بالجداول الزمنية والمواصفات الفنية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية المقابلة.

4a477f94db07bafe.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة دار الخليج للاستشارات الهندسية عن فني إنشاءات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دعم مهندس الأبنية في الإشراف على أعمال الإنشاءات، وضمان مطابقة المواصفات الفنية، وتقدير الاحتياجات من المواد والعمالة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى فني الإنشاءات مجموعة من المهام الفنية والإشرافية لضمان سير العمل وفق الخطط والمعايير المحددة، وتشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: مساعدة مهندس الأبنية في إعداد خطة وبرنامج العمل الخاص بالمعاينة ومتابعة التنفيذ وضبط الجودة. أخذ عينات من تربة موقع البناء ومواد الإنشاء والخلطات الإسمنتية، وإرسالها للمختبر للتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات. تفقد العمل في إنشاء الأبنية أثناء الإنشاء وبعده للتأكد من مطابقة جميع المواصفات الفنية والهندسية. المشاركة في قياس العمل المنجز بالتنسيق مع المهندس المشرف. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرات يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحاً يمتلك الخلفية والخبرة اللازمة لأداء المهام المذكورة بكفاءة: خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الإنشاءات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على أداء الواجبات الفنية المتعلقة بإنشاء الأبنية. معرفة بجمع العينات من تربة الموقع والمواد الإنشائية. القدرة على مطابقة المواصفات الفنية للمواد والأعمال. القدرة على تقدير كميات المواد والعمالة اللازمة للمشاريع. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع حسب متطلبات المشاريع. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

4a704156dd36fddb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اسياف التطوير للمقاولات عن كاتب استعلامات مركز خدمة عملاء للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على تقديم الدعم الأساسي للعملاء من خلال الرد على الاستفسارات ومعالجة الطلبات باستخدام قنوات الاتصال المختلفة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الرد على استفسارات العملاء الأساسية وتقديم المعلومات حول منتجات وخدمات وسياسات المنشأة. معالجة طلبات العملاء الأساسية، مثل إرسال الرسائل أو النماذج أو الوثائق الأخرى، بالإضافة إلى معالجة المعاملات المالية. حل شكاوى العملاء الأولية وإحالة المشكلات الأكثر تعقيدًا إلى مسؤول الشكاوى أو الموظف المختص. تسجيل الاستعلامات والشكاوى الواردة وتوثيق الحلول المقررة. الالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات والإجراءات التنظيمية. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال خدمة العملاء أو دور مشابه. القدرة على التعامل مع الاستفسارات والطلبات الأساسية للعملاء بفعالية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة، شفهية وكتابية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الرياض. يعمل شاغل الوظيفة ضمن مركز خدمة العملاء، حيث يتفاعل مع العملاء عبر الهاتف أو الوسائل الإلكترونية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه مسبقًا. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة اسياف التطوير للمقاولات.

4af76b68e94014ab.job_title: Program Coordinator / Project Coordinator and Cost Analyst Saudi National
4af76b68e94014ab.description: About the Role Parsons is seeking a Program Coordinator / Project Coordinator and Cost Analyst to join their team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, with operations extending to Jeddah. This full-time role is open to Saudi Nationals and involves supporting the planning, coordination, financial tracking, and successful delivery of programs and projects. The successful candidate will ensure alignment with scope, schedule, quality, and budget objectives. Key Responsibilities Coordinate multiple projects from initiation through completion, tracking milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, issues, and action items. Schedule and coordinate project meetings, workshops, reviews, and related activities, preparing agendas, presentation materials, minutes, and follow-up communications. Monitor deadlines and follow up with project team members to ensure timely completion of assignments. Maintain accurate project records, contracts, correspondence, reports, cost documentation, and supporting files. Facilitate communication among project teams, clients, consultants, contractors, vendors, and leadership. Support project closeout activities, including final documentation, lessons learned, and financial reconciliation. Identify potential project delays, risks, or challenges and escalate concerns to the appropriate manager. Track project budgets, commitments, expenditures, invoices, purchase orders, forecasts, and financial obligations. Prepare cost reports, budget summaries, variance analyses, financial projections, and management reports. Compare actual costs against approved budgets and investigate discrepancies. Support the preparation of cost estimates, pricing analyses, funding requests, and change-order evaluations. Review invoices and expense documentation for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with contractual requirements. Maintain cost databases, financial spreadsheets, project trackers, and reporting systems. Assist with monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting. Monitor labor, material, subcontractor, travel, administrative, and other project-related costs. Support earned value tracking and other project performance measurement processes, as applicable. Provide cost-related information to project managers and leadership to support informed decision-making. Required Qualifications and Skills Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Finance, Accounting, Construction Management, Engineering, Public Administration, or a related field. Experience: Approximately 2 to 3 years of experience in project coordination, program administration, cost analysis, financial tracking, or a related role. Experience coordinating schedules, budgets, documentation, project communications, and financial information. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook. Ability to prepare and maintain project budgets, cost reports, financial spreadsheets, and tracking systems. Knowledge of cost control, budget monitoring, variance analysis, forecasting, and financial reporting principles. Strong organizational, analytical, written, and verbal communication skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. High level of accuracy and attention to detail. Ability to work independently and collaboratively across multiple departments. Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment. Ability to communicate effectively with project teams, clients, consultants, contractors, vendors, and leadership. Desired Skills and Experience Experience supporting large-scale construction, infrastructure, engineering, transportation, buildings, or development projects. Experience with project management information systems, enterprise resource planning systems, cost control software, or financial reporting platforms. Experience preparing cost estimates, change-order evaluations, pricing analyses, forecasts, and funding requests. Experience with earned value management, project performance measurement, or related project controls processes. Familiarity with contracts, purchase orders, invoices, commitments, subcontractor costs, and commercial documentation. Experience supporting project closeout, financial reconciliation, lessons learned, and final reporting. Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, formulas, data analysis, dashboards, and financial models. Knowledge of project management principles, cost control procedures, and financial management practices. Experience coordinating with clients, consultants, contractors, vendors, and internal leadership. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, with responsibilities extending to Jeddah.

4a040fec22e60bb0.description: About the Role Four Points is seeking a Cook I to join our team in Riyadh. This full-time position involves preparing and cooking food items according to established recipes and quality standards, ensuring a high level of food presentation and guest satisfaction. Key Responsibilities Prepare special meals or substitute items as required. Regulate the temperature of cooking equipment such as ovens, broilers, grills, and roasters. Manage food thawing processes by pulling items from freezer storage to thaw in the refrigerator. Ensure proper portioning, arrangement, and garnishing of all food items. Maintain accurate food logs and monitor the quality and quantity of prepared food. Communicate assistance needed during busy periods and inform the Chef of excess food items for daily specials. Inform Food & Beverage service staff about menu specials and out-of-stock items. Prepare and cook food according to recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklists. Prepare cold food items. Operational Support and Compliance Assist management with hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, motivating, and coaching employees, serving as a role model. Adhere to all company and safety and security policies and procedures. Report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to the manager. Complete all required safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Anticipate and address guests’ service needs, communicating with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues, supporting the team to achieve common goals. Listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Physical Requirements Ability to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods. Ability to reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a similar culinary role. No supervisory experience is required for this position. No specific license or certification is required. Work Environment As a member of the Four Points by Sheraton community, you will contribute to an environment that values diverse backgrounds and fosters a supportive team culture. This role is based in Riyadh and is a full-time position.

We are seeking a strong leader with excellent management and communication skills, capable of overseeing daily operations, leading and motivating the team, achieving sales and profitability targets, and ensuring an exceptional customer experience while maintaining the highest standards of quality and service. Key Responsibilities: Oversee daily branch operations and ensure smooth and efficient workflow. Lead, motivate, and manage the team to achieve business objectives. Develop and implement strategies to increase sales and improve profitability. Monitor customer satisfaction and continuously improve the customer experience. Track financial and operational performance and prepare regular reports. Manage inventory and monitor operational requirements. Ensure compliance with company policies, quality standards, and safety regulations. Join Woodbury Café and become part of a growing team offering a professional work environment and opportunities for career development.

It also includes supporting the identification and development of innovative ideas to improve marketing effectiveness and customer experience. Research emerging marketing trends, technologies, consumer behaviors, and global best practices. Support the identification, assessment, and development of innovative ideas to enhance marketing effectiveness and operational efficiency. Contribute to innovation pilots and initiatives, from concept development through testing and evaluation. Conduct external benchmarking across leading marketing organizations and relevant industries. Support innovation workshops, ideation sessions, and cross-functional problem-solving activities. It also includes coordinating knowledge-sharing forums and developing content to keep Marketing teams informed of emerging practices. Capture knowledge from completed projects and convert it into reusable insights for wider Marketing teams. Develop and maintain Marketing playbooks, toolkits, frameworks, and practical guidelines. 4a757f798200dd1a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث الشركة السعودية للنقل الجماعي عن سائق شاحنة صغيرة للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تشغيل وقيادة الشاحنات الصغيرة بفعالية وأمان، مع الالتزام التام بالمسارات المحددة وقواعد المرور والسلامة، خاصة خلال موسم الحج. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تشغيل وقيادة الشاحنة الصغيرة وفقاً لمسارات العمل المحددة وخطط التشغيل المعتمدة. الالتزام الصارم بجميع قواعد المرور والأمن والسلامة، والحرص على عدم ارتكاب أي مخالفات تتعلق بالسلامة. الإبلاغ الفوري عن أي مشكلات أو أعطال قد تحدث أثناء التشغيل. التقيد التام بالأدلة الإجرائية، وأدلة المواصفات والمعايير، وسياسات وقواعد السلامة العامة للشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في قيادة الشاحنات الصغيرة أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على تشغيل المركبات والالتزام بالمسارات المحددة. معرفة جيدة بقواعد المرور والسلامة على الطرق. بيئة العمل يعمل شاغل الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة مكة المكرمة، مع التركيز على متطلبات العمل خلال موسم الحج لضمان تقديم خدمة نقل آمنة وفعالة. معلومات إضافية المنطقة: مكة المكرمة. نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: لم يتم الإفصاح عنه. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة في الشركة السعودية للنقل الجماعي.

4a70d2b03268642e.description: About the Role Ninja is looking for an experienced Area Maintenance and Facilities Manager to oversee maintenance and facilities operations across multiple stores and locations. The role focuses on ensuring equipment reliability, preventive maintenance compliance, efficient vendor management, cost control, and uninterrupted store operations. Key Responsibilities Manage reactive maintenance work orders, ensuring timely resolution and compliance with service-level agreements (SLAs). Plan and monitor preventive maintenance (PPM) activities across assigned locations. Oversee technical maintenance covering refrigeration, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, civil works, and fire and life safety systems. Manage facilities services, including cleaning, pest control, water supply, waste collection, and related services. Coordinate new-store technical handovers, snagging, warranty claims, and supplier obligations. Manage maintenance contractors, annual maintenance contracts (AMCs), service quality, quotations, and invoices. Monitor maintenance costs, work-order backlogs, recurring failures, and vendor performance. Supervise technicians, allocate resources, and ensure safe working practices and emergency coverage. Coordinate refurbishment activities, spare parts, inventory, and material requirements. Prepare regular performance reports and implement corrective action plans. Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering. Minimum 5 years of relevant multi-site maintenance experience in Saudi Arabia. Strong practical knowledge of refrigeration, HVAC, electrical systems, and preventive maintenance planning. Experience managing maintenance vendors, AMC contracts, and facilities operations. Familiarity with FSM/CAFM systems, work orders, and maintenance performance KPIs. Strong leadership, problem-solving, and cost-management skills. What We're Looking For A hands-on maintenance professional who can manage multiple locations, lead technical teams, improve equipment reliability, control maintenance costs, and support smooth day-to-day store operations.

World Architecture ranks KEO as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the #1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey. The Role of Bridge Engineers KEO International Consultants is seeking Bridge Engineers to join its team. This is a full-time position within an environment that supports professional development through global mobility and career advancement. The role involves contributing to various projects, leveraging expertise in engineering consultancy, construction supervision, and design. Key Responsibilities Applying a strong understanding of engineering drawings, technical specifications, construction methods, and applicable codes and standards. Coordinating with multidisciplinary project teams, contractors, clients, and specialist consultants.
